content: Fuse.js does fuzzy matching with no inverted index and is slow on large datasets (good typo tolerance, fine for hundreds-low thousands). FlexSearch is fastest and most memory-efficient with smallest bundle (light/English). MiniSearch is a balanced inverted-index option but not suited above ~50k records client-side. Index must be rebuilt/persisted; building a full index over thousands of records with many fields costs memory and startup time. For field-scoped search at scale, prefer an inverted-index lib (FlexSearch/MiniSearch) with per-field indexes rather than Fuse scanning all objects.
